mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_activation_ticket SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', superseded_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{subjectId}, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE subject_type = 'TENANT_ACCOUNT' AND subject_id = #{subjectId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_deleted = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.auth_activation_ticket (subject_type, subject_id, ticket_hash, status, expires_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{ticketHash}, 'ACTIVE', #{expiresAt}, #{subjectId}, #{subjectId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, subject_type, subject_id, ticket_hash, status, expires_at, consumed_time, version FROM public.auth_activation_ticket WHERE ticket_hash = #{ticketHash} AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE public.auth_activation_ticket SET status = 'CONSUMED', consumed_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND version = #{version} AND is_deleted = false
